title: MGBench: Memory Governance Benchmark for Agentic Long-Term Memory
abstract: MGBench evaluates whether agentic long-term memory systems return useful current context while preventing stale, invalidated, cross-scope, contradictory, or failed historical memory from becoming agent-usable context.

title: fidelis: zero-LLM agent memory for Claude Code and AI agents
abstract: fidelis is zero-LLM agent memory for Claude Code and AI agents: a local-first memory layer whose default retrieval path uses BM25, dense vectors, and reciprocal rank fusion with no LLM call. It returns your original passages verbatim instead of paraphrasing and runs fully local. Benchmarked on LongMemEval-S.
